notes.title: Stinger OS Update 1.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/d7b65d0ace0d5acd2e46faeba4a83205680111b3.png
I have put the game at -70% for the steam summer sales. If you bought the game at full price in the last 4 weeks, contact me via anashel@aliceandsmith.com and I'll send you the difference via paypal.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/9b9810c08f31a045c2c5f61a0e9a346405ebaf28.png
Started pre-covid, our "Going Dark" project is finally completed! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/c79865d98a70bf349517d928e79a5fb766e98e12.png

 New hacking raid event / Capture the flag
 Linux Ubuntu + Gnome now in Beta
 Incognito game mode / ability to play without any third party account
 Complete removal of Google Analytics tracking from all our websites
 Closing our Facebook ad account and removal of all our ads tracking and targeting services
 Shutdown of all our newsletter and removal of all email address
 Firing our ads agency

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/d4c4494f8f85e939c0aa8e7490651dc4b8086bb7.png

In incognito mode, your progression is saved to your steam account. You still can play from multiple computers without losing progress. From now on we will rely purely on our community for the growth and success of this game. No more targeted ads, in fact no more advertising agency. If there is a penny to be spent on promoting our game, it will be either to help journalists or fans playing with our games. If you enjoy the game, help us by leaving a review on steam or talk about it with your friends. We will follow shortly with a major rewrite of our legal privacy policy document to now support cloaking, VPN or any form of client anonymity.

For ARG events, The Black Watchmen crossover or any integration that is required to link your game with external projects, you will still be able to keep or create an A&S Accounts. Keep in mind that A&S Accounts and Incognito Mode will not be linked. These are two entirely different login systems so progression won't be shared between accounts.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/18b2c1fc912c7acfe135b2077a2786bb6814ebd2.png

This update also introduces our hacking events engine. Powered by Unreal Engine, these 'locations' are hosted on our server stack and can be targeted as part of mission or CTF events (Capture the flag). Hacking events can host a single player mission or collective missions. They can be part of storyline missions, bounty or open world.

Some of the unique features you can expect in a hacking event:

 Persistent location that can be targeted with your Stinger OS
 Live 24h/7 coverage via Signal Intelligence tools and RTMP Camera Feed
 Reset every 4 hours, similar to a dungeon in some MMOs
 Each persistent location is also streamed in real-time on Twitch
 Ability for bystanders (twitch audience) to interact and affect the location


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/175524e0cbfbd72d1df8b4ab8c33b39b787fce4c.gif

Using the same technology that we used to build the Paradox Interactive - PDXCON 2021 show, hacking events can include real life actors, similar to what you had during The Black Watchmen live event. For more information, you can watch a 'behind the scenes' clip where I explain the technology:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/e37d112684db3eb2c3156da6e63b6e86f163c90a.png
https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1032298462?t=09h02m42s




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/5df7a0c85f85b1917568753a1d3f0fdc9dc02c46.png

The first hacking location will open with Operation Smoke Screen, part of our Sec-9 storyline. This event, which is currently in beta, will show up in your mission center on July 2nd. It will be a free event for all NT4 owners. Hack an entire city block, control security cameras, take down the power grid and deploy agents on the ground to infiltrate an air gap network.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/0d891a637d729d973cb3a0eba5007eab07df4929.png
We have started the migration of both NT4 and Black Watchmen to Unity 2021. This comes with improvements to the overall loading time but also better compatibility with MacOS and Linux.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/c13d460eb876b02858707255b4d6404360865a42.png

We now finally have a stable version of NT4 under Ubuntu 18.04 /w Gnome. If testing goes well, we hope to release the Linux edition in the coming weeks.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/7cce12a638bb2367a88a701cc9c16164d25c3d26.png
Interested in giving me a hand for the summer? We have a paid internship position open! Apply here >

notes.title: Sec-9 Stealth Update
notes.content:
Greetings Agents!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/e369960fdfbf421649ccfc72d16b378dade468db.png
Following Twitch Approval, Sec-9 Closed Beta invites are now open!

Sec-9 Twitch Extension activates your Stinger OS as an overlay to the twitch stream. Not only you can enter various commands and interact with your Uplink-51 Module, you can participate in raids an attack various areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/a310424d3416ad9eaf09c3de6962e65df07cb259.gif

The Twitch Sec-9 Extension doesn't require a NITE Team 4 account. But you will need a copy of NT4 if you wish to carry out network intrusions in the Sec-9 Shibuya district.

Twitch players can send files to any NITE Team 4 agents for further investigation, password cracking, digital forensic, etc... Files sent from twitch will appear in your Stinger OS Local Folder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/5e45b7809c969897defb7e4c2ab489a5b31744d6.gif

Sec-9 brings a complete new persistent 3D universe using Unreal Engine. Alone or with a squad, you can crackdown part of Shibuya district in Tokyo, gather evidence and complete special bounties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/0a4ace6a41988d7954e5410e13cb807a6201a302.png
https://aliceandsmith.typeform.com/to/bM47joEH


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/175524e0cbfbd72d1df8b4ab8c33b39b787fce4c.gif

In the last year, we have heavily invested in our engine that manages all of our MMOARG technology, including The Black Watchmen universe of which NITE Team 4 is part of. If you wish to learn more about what we are currently working on, check out our 'Under the hood' segment during the PDXCON convention:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/e37d112684db3eb2c3156da6e63b6e86f163c90a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/8e711ba1c55e24bf48bca116c602cad606310eca.png

NT4 will now support incognito sessions, removing the needs of a third party account. Our steam policy will also be updated to allow any cloaking or VPN technology. This was the last step to complete our 'Going Dark' initiative last year that involved the removal of all tracking tools, google analytics and abolition of all ads tools and networks.

Stealth mode will be roll out on June 29th.

Black Watchmen account will still be supported for cross-play and live operations. A new companion app is on it's way to provide anonymous cellphone number and private email account for all agents. Stay tuned!

notes.title: NITE Team 4 - Going Dark
notes.content:
Deleting all players info. Shutting down our newsletter. Removing all Google Analytics.

To start off this new decade, we at Alice & Smith have challenged ourselves to pursue a world where absolutely none of our players’ information is tracked. None!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/318155c9ccbc7e0d1d81da1a1ef613eccf61c549.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/8d42747bf18c08f85ca0d3fcea416a968c2152ac.gif

Being an ARG Transmedia company makes this especially challenging, but here is some information on how we plan to change.

During the year, we will migrate our main authentication server and remove all user account creations. You are still going to be able to create or use your existing agent login nickname, but emails will not be used anymore. (No third party account anymore!)

We will delete all your email login data, and we will also purge all IP addresses and filter them in the future. We will update our Terms and Agreement and our Privacy Policy to not only allow Cloaking and VPN technology, but even encourage them.

Google Analytics and all other marketing tracking tools have already been removed from our site, and will be removed shortly from all our other touchpoints.

We are shutting down our newsletter and will delete all account history and tracking data.

We are reducing ingame playstream data to only gameplay and game mechanic optimisations by refactoring much of our code.

These changes WILL NOT impact your gameplay experience, your current progress, or your ability to keep your progress between multiple devices.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/08a39a45266956827322deeab172e46c549a4a2f.png

Our goal is to not remove the level of immersion you find in our games or projects. We still want you to receive a demonic phone call at 3 in the morning, and infiltrate the *real* website of shady heavy water vendors on the internet.

Green Level Missions, where an elected player is flown to a mystery city for a 48h immersive experience, will still require the same extensive medical and psychological evaluation. That said, we are working on a new project for our Red, Orange and Yellow clearance levels.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/92fa87d3b80c035122debffe3c8487da9667609a.png

The concept of creating an ARG companion app is nothing new. Even in one of our earliest ARGs on Unfiction we were talking about having our own dedicated communication platform.

The Black Watchmen series became our pride along with the ARGs we have had the privilege to create for our incredible clients (Paradox Interactive, White Wolf, Hello Games, Funcom...). It is important for our work to find better ways of staying in connection with you while being able to create puzzles spanning outside the game that blend digital and physical storytelling.

Some of the features we will roll out as part of our companion app:
 ARG mission alerts
 A private secure email address (your-agent-name@arg.gg)
 Your own ARG burner phone number (VoIP real landline number)
 Chat integration with Google AI for puzzle help and hints
 Looking for Group (LFG) system for puzzle solving
 Geocaching, dead drop and live drop notifications (Google Map integration)


Although we are working on this app for our own needs, we plan to make it open for any ARG creators who wish to utilize it, but don’t have the infrastructure to run it.

If you’d like to follow the project, join our (new) Telegram channel here:
http://t.me/arg_app


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/331f56a2a198f0a1bfcd08d912ff41bc223609ae.png

There are many, many ways that are much more fun than email! :)

DISCORD -> 
Our entire staff and more than 8,300 players are on discord and looking forward to chatting with you!
http://discord.gg/arg

TWITCH -> 
Follow streamers from our community! Subscribe to our official stream category.

TELEGRAM ->

http://t.me/arg_world


Cheers!

notes.title: NITE Team 4 - 1 Year
notes.content:
This is your chance to join our incredible community and discover the world of cybersecurity, hacking and cyber warfare operations (OSINT, SIGINT, HUMINT).

If you have zero knowledge of PenTest platforms, don’t worry. The Academy starts at the very basics and will help you learn the ropes. If you are curious to learn more about Kali Linux, Wireshark, SET, MITM Attacks, or even infamous tools like XKeyscore and Foxacid, take the time to read our real-world information references during your training!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/5799920eb6213d8a053846ce9bbf8165886c4812.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/8d42747bf18c08f85ca0d3fcea416a968c2152ac.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/7b31e5871eba8a066438ce556eebeb7d853c7a7a.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/a7f012a0c29c241965749deb3bb44c650307fdcb.gif

We invite everyone to help greet our new players on Discord, Twitter, and Twitch. As a veteran, do not hesitate to give them some words of encouragement and please let them feel welcome!



First 2020 Live Event
For our first Live Event of the decade, we plan to go back to our roots with a TBW-style Green Level event! A full 48-hour immersion experience: show up with your passport at an agreed meeting point and we fly one of you to a mystery location with the NT4 community as your only support.

More info on our next Live Event will be announced soon, starting with the opening of the Green Level application form and the unlocking of both the Orange and Yellow clearance levels.


Feel free to leave us a comment in the steam forums or join us on discord: http://discord.gg/arg

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Goliath-7 Live
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/e6c07d09f9dc99cd651a0a36c72f42748c2302cc.jpg


Stinger OS Upgrade System Goliath-7 >
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/c7626b23dbab50b5a88e75b16f6b7ccc2504d28d.gif
Goliath-7 is a new upgrade platform that lets you increase the capacity of your Stinger OS.


 Goliath-7 is a new upgrade platform that lets you increase the capacity of your Stinger OS
 CPU upgrades: Boost CPU intensive module like Password Attack
 Proxy upgrades: Increase the number of servers you can use to speed up the process of scanning various networks
 Database upgrades: Bigger xkeyscore requests, capacity and processing speed
 Software upgrades: Add new modules and game mechanics.
 Upgrades can be permanent or temporary
 Upgrades range in power, from common to legendary




New Content >
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/358d5d111216ed29b2c54c2b2827542afa5e2339.jpg
6 new open-world missions are released in echo to the unprecedented G7 Cyber Attack simulation in real life (Read more on Reuters).

In this alternate reality, the vulnerability report prepared by the G7 during the attack simulation has fallen into the wrong hands, and NT4 has to race against time to plug the leak before attackers can wreak havoc on the US economy.

7 new bounties will also be added to the current world drop. These bounties will give you the chance to infiltrate the infamous SureFire military arms dealer and collect really cool Goliath-7 upgrades along the way.



Twitch Drop 2.0 >
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/6ad36b1a1771f7d58df33323d82329702f2ab903.jpg
Watching a NITE Team 4 stream on twitch will now give you a chance to earn a Goliath-7 upgrade item. Every 60 seconds, a loot table will be rolled for everyone watching the stream. If you win, a notification will be displayed in the streamer’s Stinger OS, and the item will be added to your inventory.

We have also added a nice reward for the host. If you are streaming NITE Team 4 on twitch with a minimum of 20 viewers, you will automatically gain an rare, epic or legendary upgrade after 15 minutes. Other rewards will also be earned after 30 minutes, 45 minutes and 60 minutes.

To be eligible, both streamer and spectators need to enable their twitch drop setting here: Twitch Drop Campaign.

Our Discord Server now features a stream's channel where you can get alerts of any ongoing stream within the community.

Watching a stream as a group can be fun and also rewarding. We are planning to add special events, missions, and bounties that will be unlocked by all participants in a stream and could be played as a group. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.10
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/f7466199b9fdaa474433cc22a52cf0018418ece7.jpg

Hello Agents,

The new Open World mission, titled Disinformation Sharing is now available for all players! For this mission, the usual 3 parts will be released over the next 3 days. Members of the G7 are conducting a series of simulated cyber attacks against their own financial sectors in an effort to increase cyber-security and provide multi-national information sharing. NITE Team 4 is tasked to work in secret alongside the NSA and US Cyber Command to conduct the American tests.

Here are the patch notes:

New features

 New Open World Mission G7 2019 Part One - Disinformation Sharing
 Added a new variable in the Social Engineering Toolkit configuration in the CMS/Hivemind Creator, letting you set the success rate of your SET attack. A visual indicator was also added in the game to let you know if you reach that threshold.


Bugfix

 Fixed a bug in the Open World that caused Xkeyscore entities to not be properly given when downloaded from the Open World menu.
 Fixed a bug that caused some players to not be able to click on the FAY Action Required button.
 Fixed a bug that allowed players to simultaneously drag a window will resizing another.
 Fixed a bug that caused Audio to not play at the start of the game for new players.
 The Notepad will now always be shown on top of the UI, even in the Open World and Bounties menus.
 Fixed a bug that caused the mouse cursor to stay in “resize mode” when quitting a module via keyboard shortcut

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.9
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/fd098305d34e3497bd1b93e942232e1032e797fb.jpg

Hello agents,

Before we start production on the next Open World mission, we wanted to take some quality time to revise the different aspects of StingerOS’s UI that we thought could use some improvements.

We’ve listened to you, the community, and implemented many of the suggestions that were heavily requested. We think these changes will make StingerOS more intuitive and enjoyable to use.

Here are the patch notes :

New features

 It is now possible to resize Terminals and Image Viewer windows.
 The UI is more responsive and the elements on the top corners will now collapse when a module or terminal is near them. This was done to alleviate the UI depending on the needs of the player.
 Multi-Monitor Support (Beta) has been added to the game for up to 3 monitors. The feature requires that all monitors be on the same native resolution before starting the game in order to work properly.
 Drastically reduced loading time at the start of the game, allowing faster access to the Mission Center.
 Added an option allowing you to set the opacity for active and inactive windows.
 The Open World and Bounty missions have now been moved to the Mission Center interface, alongside the Academy and Story Mode. All of the game’s primary content can now be accessed in one area.
 Open World and Bounty missions will now unlock in tandem with Story Mode, after completing Basic Operations in the Academy. This is to allow a better game flow for new players.


Bugfix

 Fixed a bug that caused the level up from 2 to 3 to not properly trigger at the end of CastleIvy.
 Fixed a bug in the CMS that prevented players from accessing file browsers created in the legacy API.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the Open World mission objective to properly refresh when resetting the mission.
 Fixed a bug in Xkeyscore where a removed entity would still be considered in a search when it should have been removed entirely
 Fixed a bug that caused the Active Directory and File browsers to refresh automatically whenever a command was made in another workspace.
 Fixed an interface bug caused by having multiple Phone CID Backdoor modules opened on the same workspace.
 Fixed an issue that caused Xkeyscore to continue scanning after clicking on the Reset button.
 The input field for the Active Directory and FileBrowser is now much longer, to cover it’s perceived length.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the resolution setting to save properly

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/6bcd47e8f598c22b625b46bb0ad3396f15467544.jpg

Hello Agents,

As we continue our ongoing efforts to improve NITE Team 4 and consolidate our foundation in order to support our next steps to bring the game to another level, we wanted to give a small gift to you, our players! That’s why we’re happy to announce the release of Steam Trading cards for our game! Collect them and receive cool rewards to decorate your Steam profile in the colours of NITE Team 4!

Here are the official patch notes containing the features and bugfixes included in this new version:

New features

 Steam Trading Cards
 The NITE Team 4 Demo is now back on the Steam page! It includes: Academy - Basic Ops, Chapter 1 of Operation CastleIvy, as well as access to the Hivemind
 The Open World missions will now display clearer objectives. Clicking on the objective button will also redirect you straight to the Open World Part you are currently in, instead of the Open World main interface
 Added an “Abort Training” button in the Academy, which acts the same way as the “Abort Chapter” function of the main missions, resetting your current certification.
 The Com Center has been removed as it was no longer in use, thus freeing up a previously used Workspace


Bugfix

 Added a drop down menu for the Resolution selection
 Fixed a bug that made it impossible to change or remove a file browser target host when an invalid address was entered
 Fixed a bug preventing players from opening TBW Archive images after they were saved to the CaseFile
 Important Domains found in an Xkeyscore document will now be added automatically to the Terminal autocompletes upon viewing the document
 Fixed some typos located in Open World briefing documents
 Phone CID Backdoor profile pictures had a visual upgrade
 Fixed a bug that caused the WMI Scanner to continue scanning even after using the cancel command
 Fixed an issue that caused problems with the Globe animation (Palatura Mode engaged)
 Slightly reduced the Glitch effect on the Hacknet Skin
 In Xkeyscore, the No Relation/Partial Relation pop up will now close automatically once a new selection has been made (It’s no longer necessary to manually click on the Close button to remove the pop up)
 Succeeding a Password Attack will no longer show a “Try Again” button, but rather a “Return” button
 Fixed a visual glitch that caused the Xkeyscore timer to briefly show 00:00:00 before counting down
 NotePad highlight is now more visible
 Fixed a bug that caused the UI to be interactive at the end of Royal Gate’s end cutscene when it should not have been
 Changed the icon and name of the Settings button to StingerOS

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/69d5f691229b2940a0e0641e303f5cb22d80a948.jpg

Greetings Agents,

Our team continues to work hard to improve NITE Team 4 and deliver quality content for you all! Speaking of which, April’s Open World mission, titled Ransom Where, is now available to play! 
The husband of a business magnate in Iceland was kidnapped and they were not released after payment was made. Find out who the abductors are and bring them to justice!

We’ve also made modifications to the Notepad and fixed bugs in existing modules.
You can find the official patch notes here:

New Features!

 New Open World Campaign: April 2019 - Ransom Where.
 Custom tabs have been added to the NotePad module in order to store more information.
 The Unity Pop up will no longer appear when starting the game. You can now change your graphics resolution in the Settings Menu, under Graphics.


Bugfixes

 Added the mission briefing audio and images to the Asset Cache (you can store game assets on your hard drive by checking the “Preload Media Assets” option in the Settings menu, under General).
 The Hacknet and Uplink skins will now appear under the Featured Skins menu in Settings (Provided you have them unlocked).
 The Temporary Turbine C2 card timer will now start beeping at 30 seconds and increase in tempo as it reaches 0, to give better audio feedback on how much time is remaining to the connection.
 Removed the “frame” icons in the Image Viewer module, as it was obstructing the images.
 Some typos fixed in Xkeyscore documents.
 Aborting a Chapter will now correctly erase FoxAcid autofill information gathered from that chapter.
 Resetting the game during Operation Royal Gate will now properly remove the Andromeda Shell from the player’s StingerOS, as intended.
 Fixed a bug that caused Xkeyscore to stop responding after multiple uses.
 The music will now be quieter during dialogue segments.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/f5747422e7b58e7c8fe48a305ea696d7410a6f62.jpg

New features!

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/535df4a02acfa4699007a844fedd2471673c339c.jpg

Now that we have infiltrated Humans Solution Consulting, you will be able to level up within the ranks and uncover more intel on this secret organization and their illicit operations.

On top of the 5 new missions and 12 special bounties, you will also play with new exploits and rootkit!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/7b31e5871eba8a066438ce556eebeb7d853c7a7a.gif

Open World Campaign : January

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/b6efcb2cbd6d780a8c1b102e4b2c0e17a7e280f0.jpg

An internet privacy watchdog group leaked a series of documents, known as the Manila Folder, including a memo from FeedPaths about potential manipulation in an upcoming election.

notes.title: Hacking: Cyber Range
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/8d51286136eb5e2968710cfa5ecd8498bd060cd2.jpg

The new patch introduces the largest and most complex update we’ve ever had in the last two years of development. Partnership with Uplink, new Hivemind Cyber Range universe, the launch of the Game Editor Toolset and more!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/8b29c91d375fc9185361645f14bcd2f4be24a8c5.gif

Hivemind was initially a covert communications network between Intelligence Agencies, similar to SIPRnet. Over time, mercenary organisations joined the network and it is now an underground cyber range, a virtual environment used for cyber-warfare training and technical development. It provides tools that help strengthen the stability, security and performance of cyberinfrastructures and IT systems used by government and military agencies.

As a player, you can access this sandbox via the Hivemind icon at the bottom of your screen, (5th Icon). More than 63 Hiveminds are currently being built with a variety of difficulties and challenges. It’s a huge undertaking and we hope it will add a completely new playstyle to NITE Team 4.

Player Created Servers can be rated based on fun, difficulty and content quality. You also have the average time it will take to break in. Other types of ratings and filters will be added later, to give you more control over what type of cyber range you wish to play with.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/7dfd71caafdca68afa1408daa422a6ef2121cf12.png

https://s3.amazonaws.com/media.niteteam4.com/uplink.png

In 2001, Introversion Software had created a game that would kick off a genre: hacking simulation game. Uplink has won countless awards and achieved a cult status for many members in the hacking games community.

Starting today, all Uplink owners will automatically get a unique Stinger OS skin. To unlock the skin, you just need to have Uplink in your steam library.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/21782b2058b62d5663978d8a76de128b1cb31ca9.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/4de0838aa4f7a9feac42b1070af26ac717b5a631.jpg

Owners of the Network Administrator can design and create their own Cyber Range in the Hivemind network. In the Stinger OS, a new icon on your left will give you a link to the game editor.

Network Administrator has access to a dashboard showing how many players have access to the cyber range, who succeeded and the global experience they had. The editor includes the same tools we used to design and create all of the missions in NITE Team 4 with some limitations, to keep things simple.

You can create your own technologies and vulnerabilities. Design puzzles of any type, with many network layers to break in and investigate. Advanced Module includes File Browser support, Active Directory, Smart Phone and even Man in the Middle attacks.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/544390/extras/01-BootCamp.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/544390/NITE_Team_4/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/971750/NITE_Team_4_Network_Administrator/

notes.title: Update 0.11.2
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/23300fc083fe9525eb6317808b604acf6c313bdf.jpg

Introducing new bounty!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/bd73147e6d69728df55d70b7bb646048f759613a.gif

The new bounty system gives you access to 10 bounties (normal, rare, and epic) from the Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) and the French General Directorate for External Security (DGSE).

Every hour you have a 75% chance to receive a bounty mission of unknown rarity. Common bounties give you 60 minutes to complete the mission, but the more rare the bounty the less time you will have! When you successfully complete a rare bounty, you will be automatically granted a Epic bounty, each with a unique reward:
Successfully completing the CSIS Epic bounty will grant the Phoenix Skin
 
Successfully completing the DGSE Epic bounty will grant the Private Investigator avatar (50% chance of Light or Dark version)


The full bounty system will include hourly, daily and weekly drops from intelligence agencies across the globe. Bounties will also drop based on real-life timezones. So if it’s daytime in China, daily or weekly bounties from the Ministry of State Security will start to appear. Your reputation with some agencies will also unlock exclusive bounties and some secret questlines. The new reputation dashboard lets you see your current standing with these agencies.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/c9a40d9b405baf1dd16277a35e58cd2c7c6eacb3.gif

November content drop!
We are working hard on the November content drop, with plans for 5 new missions in the academy and 6 new official missions in the Season 1 campaign. While you wait, there is still time to get your exclusive Early Access skin! And if you are an owner of the Black Watchmen or Ahnayro, new skins have been introduced for you!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/8c4ff47c06e627c096ae2ae04eca92b8fc98c26b.jpg

Key features in 0.11.02:

    New filters in XKeyscore: You can now display only relevant entities to help you in your research. Filter entities by their tags : Alpha, Beta, Mission Center, Academy, or Open World.
    New Career screen: Available in the Agent Profile, you can now check your reputation and overall progression.
    Mission resets: You can now replay the Open World Campaign
    Steam achievements: New achievements have been added, including some secret achievements.
    Bounty improvements: You can now accept or decline a bounty. The bounty screen now also displays a countdown to the next bounty drop.
    New Skins: The Black Watchmen skin and Special Ops title will be granted to all players who have TBW in their Steam library. The new Ahnayro skin will be granted to all players who have Ahnayro in their Steam library.


Quality of life improvements:

    Dylan’s transcript in the Academy will now auto-scroll
    Current XP and XP to reach your next rank are now displayed onscreen
    Changed the input field placeholder in the Password Attack module to be more clear
    Improved navigation within the bounty system
    Completed bounties are now removed from your inventory
    The text of your current objective is now non-clickable to prevent UI elements overlapping
    You can now submit the answer to a bounty by typing Enter
    F.A.Y will now speak only once, the first time you launch a specific module. If you launch the same module again no voice will play. Next week we will introduce this as a toggled sound setting.
    Added a small delay before Dylan speaks when you complete a training in the Academy, so the success sound effect won’t overlap with Dylan’s voice
    Updated the quality settings, this will hopefully help players who are having issues with shaders in the satellite heatmap and agent profile
    Visual update of the Redeem section in the Agent Profile
    The mission center will now move you to the next active chapter when you finish a mission.
    A hard reset of the game will now erase your XKEYSCORE and Foxacid entities, and grant you the basic entity pack as if you were a new player.
    Minor visual improvements to the item rewards screen
    Visual fix of the animation when you unlock a new category in the Academy


Thank you so much for your support and helping us improve the game during early access. Feel free to leave us a comment in the steam forums or join us on discord: http://discord.gg/arg

Cheers!

notes.title: Closed Beta Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/34237edb162cb0971486ec7143ca612cd7edf3d9.jpg

Open World - Early Access and more!!!

Patrick Greatbatch (co-author of The Black Watchmen) is back with a new set of open-world missions starting in October! Open-world missions blend in-game investigation with real world research involving websites, emails, phone numbers, etc. to increase the level of immersion and realism.

The first set of missions takes the player into the inner workings of a secretive government organization, private prisons and deep-rooted political corruption. The investigation is ripped from the headlines and explores complex problems facing real world governments today.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/04a4f2204a34c3679367012b0f6c707905a2d9b6.jpg

October 2nd will be our official Early Access kickoff party at SecTor 2018! The event will be streamed online on our NT4 Twitch Channel. If you are in the Toronto Area, let us know- we have a couple of VIP Tickets for you!

With the release of Early Access comes a set of new rewards! NT4 Hoodies, Military Backpacks, Trench Coats and The Park (Steam Key). To celebrate the event we have created 3 new NT4 Skin for each of the Secret World Legends factions: Illuminati, Dragon and Templar.

These new skins will be automatically given to anyone who owns Secret World Legends in their Steam library.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/68b10badce2b47f7199bae36f3b2bee7f6cf0775.jpg

The new academy is live and will have more than 25 missions. Basic Terminal Operations is accessible right now and will be followed by Digital Forensics next week. Each training exercise is fully voice acted with Sergeant Catherine Wheeler and Security Analyst Dylan.

Also, the team started working on a new module called Blackhound. The module combines existing tools like Cobalt Strike and Bloodhound to focus on privilege escalation and pivoting. You can learn more about Bloodhound here >>

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/31a9f8138020f62cf9d8c50b18ce35eee91edeb4.jpg

Cheers!

notes.title: Certification Center
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/0e00532d27f972f51ad28d4f3b523c7feb41fa15.jpg

Hi everyone! We are excited to show you some of our ongoing work on the Academy, the training and tutorial center of NT4.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/6adba0eb8e04fad257ebcb1487e2d263df6e0d75.jpg

The Academy will include 5 certifications and 15 training missions at launch. These will teach you about the various tools and techniques featured in Stinger OS. Certification topics include:

Network Intrusion
Open Source Intelligence
Social Engineering
Data Forensics
Advanced Attack Vectors
And many more...


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/eede0feafd4469a87547e38a9af245b1cef4e475.jpg

The goal of the certification center is to give you everything you need to know to master all of your hacking modules, attack strategies, and features of the Stinger OS. (Workspaces, multithreading, advanced terminal commands, etc…)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/97a3191cbf35d862dd669a368283a4ff3e717eff.jpg

You will be able to earn three levels of mastery for each certification. (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) These levels are based on the speed and precision of your attack. For example, to identify potential entry points on an external network, OSINTSCAN should always be your first source for information gathering, since it is less noticeable than a SFUZZER dictionary attack on a DNS server.

Next week, we will introduce our new Social Engineering Toolkit for mass mailing and spear phishing a target network.

We have just updated the Closed Beta branch on steam and want to share with you the new modules and features available for testing!


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/965f336ef4ecd7858a3600f329fff18fd14b5ab0.gif

The new mission center is now unlocked with your first mission from GCHQ, the United Kingdom’s Intelligence Agency. The mission includes 4 objectives and one optional task.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/38e8ea570b765d109b8cf0244263e19938d4be35.gif

We have also introduced a new briefing mechanic with much more lore and storytelling content, to help you get immersed in the life of a special agent.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/c3f7aaf833f16f75c5e763d899fc4a614d1aaf32.gif

Optional tasks come with choices and consequences which affect your reputation with the other intelligence agencies. Hide intel, save undercover agents lives or expose them for the kill; your actions will shape the storyline and unlock new content.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/62413abc56b26fa9631ab2089755fb6cfe69f6ab.gif

Data Forensics has been upgraded with a new SCP / SSH module. Infiltrate computers and browse files and folders for key information, or remove the evidence of your hack.


The mission is available now and will reset every time you close the game. You cannot permanently gain or lose reputation for now. Version 0.9 does not come with any tutorial, and the new mission will require familiarity and understanding of the Stinger OS.

As always, you can reach us on Discord or in the forums. We are grateful for your support and hope you enjoy the ever-evolving Black Watchmen universe!
